newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen weak ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen weak ahead of weekend.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to open weak on Thursday ahead of the Friday-Saturday weekend, with institutions on the sidelines, dealers said.
They said an already bearish market was unlikely to react to the plunge in Asian markets after Wall Street tumbled.
On Wednesday, the Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 3.57 points, or 0.25 percent, to end at 1,413.12. Losers led gainers 199 to 41.
Turnover rose to 36.73 million shares from 32.07 million in the previous session.
